description: Cross-SDK conformance vectors for the SCA hosted-ceremony client: the redirect callback parser, redirect URI and ceremony-origin rules, ceremony timeouts, and the error vocabulary. The iOS SDK's Conformance/ScaCallbackV1.json is canonical; every copy must be byte-identical to it.

conventions.generatedStrings: Any string input may instead be {"repeat": s, "count": n} (s repeated n times) or {"concat": [parts]} (the parts, each a string or a generated string, joined). Oversized inputs are always generated, never inlined.

callbackOutcomes.result: The ceremony completed; result is the exact decoded payload text.
callbackOutcomes.error: The page reported code; message is the decoded message, or null when absent or not kept.
callbackOutcomes.protocolError: The callback is off contract and ends the ceremony.
callbackOutcomes.stateMismatch: iOS only: the callback's state is missing or not this ceremony's; ends the ceremony.
callbackOutcomes.ignored: Android only: the callback is not provably this ceremony's (wrong target, size or field cap, malformed fragment, missing or wrong state), so it is dropped and the ceremony keeps waiting.

conventions.perPlatform: Where the SDKs differ by design, expected is {"ios": outcome, "android": outcome}. The differences: iOS ends a ceremony on a callback it cannot attribute, Android ignores it; iOS caps the callback at 96 KiB, the payload at 64 KiB decoded, and the message at 1 KiB, Android caps the callback at 64 KiB and 12 fields.

errorVocabulary.notes: iOS reports Cancelled as DaaScaError.cancelled; Android reports it as DaaScaResult.Cancelled, not a DaaScaError. Neither SDK has a NotEnrolled case.
